in_marathi.name: Ahanish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ahanish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ahanish is derived from the Sanskrit word 'aham' meaning 'I' and 'anish' meaning 'shining' or 'radiant'. This name is given to a child who is believed to be a source of light and positivity in the world. In Hindu mythology, the god Ahan, the personification of the sun, is a symbol of power, strength, and illumination. Thus, Ahanish is a powerful and auspicious name for a baby boy.
